notes.title: Space physics puzzler Voyager 2 adds Linux and Steam Deck support
notes.content:
For people who love space, Voyager 2 is a game about probing the solar system and now it has Linux / Steam Deck support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/space-physics-puzzler-voyager-2-adds-linux-and-steam-deck-support/

notes.title: Voyager 2 available for Linux & Steam Deck
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42692186/53996c4768bad336cd2d5a3854dea265f6a54ce6.jpg"][/img]

[b]Voyager 2 now ships with a native Linux build and full Steam Deck support![/b]

[h2]What’s New[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Native Linux executable[/b]
[*]Steam Deck tested for performance and compatibility
[*]Fully playable with touchscreen and gamepad controls  
[*]Per-input control profiles*
[/list]
* Control settings are fully customizable per input type, so if you like to pull back to aim (slingshot-style) on a touchscreen but push forward to aim with a control stick, you have that option. And your settings follow even if you switch between control schemes on the fly!

[h2]What We Haven’t Tested (Yet)[/h2]
[list]
[*]Desktop Linux distributions other than SteamOS (Ubuntu, Arch, Fedora, etc.)  
[/list]
If you play on a non-Deck Linux PC, we’d love to hear about performance, input quirks, or crashes. Share your feedback using the in-game socials (Gear Icon > Options > Email) or in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2076660"]Community Hub[/url].

[h2]How to Launch the Native Version[/h2]
[list]
[*]Update Voyager 2 to the latest version
[*]Select Voyager 2 > View game details > Gear icon > Properties > Compatibility
[*]Ensure "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool" is [b]unchecked[/b]  
[*]Press Play. Steam will launch the native build automatically
[/list]
Thanks for playing [i]Voyager 2[/i] on PC, Mac, and now Linux and Steam Deck!

-Rumor Games

notes.title: Version 1.100 Release: Sounds of the Earth
notes.content:
[h2]Think Globally, Play Locally[/h2]

The world speaks many languages, and now so does Voyager 2! We're delighted to announce that the game now supports 15 languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Polish, Indonesian, Turkish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, and Thai. Navigate the Solar System in your native language and enjoy the cosmos like never before.

This update represents a tremendous amount of work and testing, but there's always a chance something gets overlooked. Please report any translation errors, as well your thoughts and feedback, using the in-game contact options or our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2076660/discussions/]discussion board[/url].

[h2]In Case You Missed It[/h2]

Over the past year, we've been quietly working to enhance Voyager 2 with new features, bug fixes, and performance improvements. From refining gameplay mechanics to improved controller support, the game has evolved a great deal since launch.

To avoid confusion, we're adopting a new version numbering system to better reflect the game's growth and align with our other titles. Welcome to version 1.100! This marks the most significant update since launch, paving the way for future enhancements and ensuring a smoother experience.

[h2]What's Next[/h2]

We're not done yet though! In the future we have plans for a Linux release and full native Steam Deck support, followed later by Steam Achievements. Keep an eye out for future updates, and thank you so much for your continued support!

Godspeed, Voyagers! ːsteamthisː

notes.title: Steam Space Exploration Fest featuring Voyager 2
notes.content:
[i]Voyager 2[/i] is part of the Steam Space Exploration Fest, and we're celebrating with our [b]biggest discount ever![/b] If you've been on the fence, now is the perfect time to jump in!

Launch Voyager and other specialized space probes on a Grand Tour of the Solar System, carefully aiming your trajectory to scan, orbit, and land on planets. Learn the secrets of gravitational slingshots to reach distant targets, built out a Deep Space Network to relay signals, and transmit your findings back to Earth!

We've been hard at work since launch: releasing a macOS version, improving gamepad controls, and adding new accessibility options. So explore [i]Voyager 2[/i] for yourself at its best price ever September 2-9 at Steam Space Exploration Fest!

notes.title: Voyager 2 Update v0.110
notes.content:
[h1]New Feature[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42692186/29378f4ec5e69ad299007f47c240d330bca88f1b.png[/img]
There are plenty of challenges to be found in Voyager 2. But if you ever find yourself stuck on a mission, sometimes it's a good idea to take a step back and look at it with fresh eyes later.

That's why, in order to give players more flexibility in the order they play missions, we're introducing [b]skips[/b]. Press and hold the circle where your record would appear when you win a mission (bottom left of the mission select screen) to skip it and move on to the next mission! Come back later and complete the mission to free up the skip to use again.

Of course, with such a powerful tool there are a few, uh, provisos, a couple of quid pro quos:

[h3]Rule #1[/h3]
You only get three [strike]wishes[/strike] skips. (But completing a skipped mission restores that skip to use again)

[h3]Rule #2[/h3]
You can't skip a mission with a tutorial until you've played the tutorial once.

[h3]Rule #3[/h3]
You can't skip the final mission.

[i][b]Good luck completing them all![/b][/i]


[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Increased the sensitivity area of slingshot by 50%
[*]Probes now fade out if they get too close to the camera during a replay
[*]On the mission select screen, the next available mission is now selected automatically
[*]Added explanation popups for new skip feature and for favoriting replays on the replay menu
[*]Updated tutorials to change instructions depending on player's input method (mouse & keyboard, gamepad/controller, or touchscreen)
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue in the Research menu where the chosen rocket would sometimes change on its own
[*]Fixed an issue in the Replay menu where some replays couldn't be selected using gamepad controls
[*]Fixed an issue where a corrupted save file would prevent players from progressing in the game
[*]Fixed bugs related to the "reset save data" feature
[/list]

notes.title: Voyager 2 Launches Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42692186/5bcd9450934f15041294521943693272cc4c6600.png[/img]

It's time to fuel up your boosters and start plotting your trajectories, because Voyager 2 is now ready for liftoff!

The space program is on the verge of collapse due to budget cuts, until a stalwart rocket scientist discovers a storage closet filled to the brim with Voyager space probes. Use your wits and real principles of rocket science to solve devious gravity-bending puzzles and save the program.

Experiment to find the perfect launch parameters and watch your probe soar through the cosmos on a mission to collect and relay scientific data. What's your reward? Furthering humanity's knowledge of the universe, restoring the public's interest in space travel, and of course, a beautiful replay of what your probe actually saw on during its flyby!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42692186/c23cdda9c6a911938a38d09c8e2699d4d42e848f.png[/img]
